data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a provenance-aware skip path to `ci.yml:llm-review`: before dispatching the LLM reviewer on a session→main PR, call `verify-session-provenance.sh`. On exit 0 (all commits provenanced via either `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailers OR linked-PR signals), skip the LLM dispatch with an explicit "covered-by-sub-PR-reviews" liveness assertion (check-run conclusion `skipped` with a summary message listing covered sub-PR numbers and SHAs). On exit 1 (unprovenanced) or exit 2 (budget-exhausted), keep the current full-diff path. Ship a contract test that locks the `verify-session-provenance.sh` 0/1/2 exit-code semantics for future consumers.

**Why**: Today every session→main PR triggers a cumulative-diff review that fails closed on 6000+ line diffs. With per-sub-PR review (S1) plus provenance verification, the integration review can be skipped when all commits are already covered — the regression class behind 1624-5fb9 is closed.

**Scope**:
- IN: `ci.yml:llm-review` modification (add provenance check + skip branch); check-run summary text format; contract test for `verify-session-provenance.sh` exit-code semantics; existing `Suppress prior defenses for integration review` (`ci.yml:523`) interaction.
- OUT: `verify-session-provenance.sh` itself is not modified (only consumed); cycle ledger keying (S2); RED-test-blocker (S4).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `ci.yml:llm-review` calls `verify-session-provenance.sh` before dispatching the LLM reviewer and routes on exit code: `0 → skip with "covered-by-sub-PR-reviews" check-run conclusion`; `1 → full-diff path (current behavior)`; `2 → full-diff path (budget-exhausted)`.
  ← Satisfies: "Integration review at session→main (ci.yml:llm-review) reuses the existing verify-session-provenance.sh logic"

- When this story is complete, the skip path emits a PR check-run summary message of the form: `"Covered by sub-PR reviews: PR#<num1>:<sha1>, PR#<num2>:<sha2>, ..."` listing every commit's covering sub-PR.
  ← Satisfies: "explicit covered-by-sub-PR-reviews liveness assertion (check-run conclusion skipped + summary message listing covered sub-PR numbers and SHAs)"

- When this story is complete, a contract test (`tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance-contract.sh`) asserts the verifier's exit-code semantics: 0 = all provenanced; 1 = at least one unprovenanced commit; 2 = GH_BUDGET exhausted. Future changes to the verifier that break this contract fail the test.
  ← Satisfies: "A contract test ships with this epic locking the verifier's 0/1/2 exit-code semantics"

- When this story is complete, a synthetic test fixture exercises a 6000+ line all-provenanced session→main PR that completes without LLM dispatch (verifying SC1's synthetic verification path).
  ← Satisfies: "a synthetic test exercises a 6000+ line all-provenanced session→main PR that completes without LLM dispatch"

- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic.
  ← Satisfies: TDD Done-of-Done requirement

## Considerations

- [Correctness] The `Suppress prior defenses for integration review` step at `ci.yml:523` already addresses sub-PR vs integration suppression under the OLD sha-only keying. S2's re-keying changes the key shape. S3 must verify this suppression step still works correctly under the new key — either S2 already updated it (preferred) or this story does the update.
- [Correctness] S3 changes ci.yml:llm-review behavior from "always run on session→main" to "conditionally skip". This is a CONTRACT-PRESERVING BEHAVIOR CHANGE per the SC5(c) epic-level carve-out: the job invocation surface is unchanged, but execution outcome is data-dependent on `verify-session-provenance.sh`. Document this in the ADR drafted by the doc-story.
- [Reliability] When `verify-session-provenance.sh` exits 2 (budget-exhausted), the full-diff path runs. This is the safe fallback — never silently skip.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO operator, the integration review at session->main skips redundant LLM dispatch when all commits are provenanced via sub-PR reviews
